title: Prose promotion
description: Promotional register: travel-brochure puffery, strategy-deck vocabulary, and the adjective-noun and verb habits that carry a claim no measurement backs.

rules.name: Use neutral, specific language
rules.message: puffery: {match} -- replace with the fact that would justify it

match.pattern: \bnestled (?:in|between|among|alongside|within) (?:the|a)?\b|\b(?:in|at) the heart of\b|\brich cultural heritage\b|\brich (?:history and|and diverse|and vibrant)\b|\bvibrant (?:community|culture|ecosystem|atmosphere)\b|\bnatural beauty\b|\ba (?:hub for|hub of|dynamic hub|thriving hub|cultural hub)\b|\ba beacon (?:of|for)\b|\ba treasure trove (?:of|for)\b|\ba (?:shining|prime) example\b|\ba masterclass in\b|\ba testament to (?:the|its)\b|\brenowned for (?:its|their)\b|\bwidely (?:regarded as|recognized as|considered)\b|\bhas emerged as (?:a|the)\b|\bhas established itself as\b|\bcontinues to (?:thrive|grow|inspire)\b|\bleft an indelible (?:mark|impact)\b|\bleaving an indelible mark\b|\bleft a lasting (?:impact|impression)\b|\bleaving a lasting impact\b|\b(?:a lasting|enduring) legacy\b|\benduring impact\b

examples.bad: The library has emerged as a hub for astronomy tooling.
examples.good: Four astronomy tools depend on the library.

examples.bad: The rewrite left a lasting impact on latency.
examples.good: The rewrite cut p99 latency from 800 ms to 120 ms.

examples.bad: The city is renowned for its harbour.
examples.good: The city is home to the country's largest harbour.

examples.bad: The file format continues to thrive.
examples.good: The file format continues to evolve; version 3 adds streaming reads.

rules.fix: Delete the phrase, or replace it with the number or fact behind it.

citation.note: The register `prose-inflation.slop-lexicon` does not reach: that rule owns single marketing ADJECTIVES (robust, seamless), while this owns multi-word travel-and-biography CONSTRUCTIONS. Zero of 55 source tokens were matched by any owned rule, which is why it ships at error rather than warning -- unlike `AICompoundPhrases`, none of these phrases has an ordinary technical use. Human labelling, 2026-10: three phrases that read as neutral description were removed -- `is home to` (a containment idiom; the puffery, when present, is in the words that follow it), `continues to evolve` (states change, not merit), and `renowned for his/her` (a person's reputation in a profile or tribute is the subject, not a sales claim). `renowned for its/their` stays for places and products.

rules.name: Describe the mechanism
rules.message: strategy buzzword: {match} -- describe the actual mechanism or advantage

examples.good: The cache holds 8 TB no competitor can re-derive without our sensor feed.
Each new user contributes a review, which raises search ranking.

rules.fix: Name the loop or the barrier, and what makes it hold.

citation.note: `north star` alone is in `prose-inflation.business-jargon`; the flywheel, moat, network-effect, and land-grab bands are not, and they are the ones that appear in generated strategy prose. Exception `defined-term-of-art` exists because `network effect` is a real term in economics writing.

rules.name: Cut the promotional adjective
rules.message: promotional adjective: {match} -- delete it, or give the measurement

examples.good: This release removes the last Python 3.9 dependency.

rules.fix: Delete the adjective. If the claim matters, replace it with the number behind it.

citation.note: The source rule is Vale `extends: sequence` with a `JJ` + `NN|NNS` tag pair. This engine has no part-of-speech tagging outside `kind: vocabulary`, so the noun side is approximated by a following lowercase word -- narrower than the tagger on hyphenated and capitalised nouns, and that under-match is the safe direction. `holistic`, `seamless`, and `comprehensive` are omitted: already owned by `prose-inflation.slop-lexicon`, and a second rule on the same token would double-count in the density budget.

rules.name: Use the direct verb
rules.message: promotional verb: {match} -- use the direct verb

examples.bad: The demo showcases the new parser.
examples.good: The demo runs the new parser on three files.

rules.fix: Use the plain verb: "showcase" is "show", "harness" is "use", "embark on" is "start", "foster" is "encourage" or "cause".

citation.note: The source rule is `extends: sequence` with verb tags; without a tagger this is a token list. `navigate` and its inflections are omitted because they are the standard UI instruction verb. `leverage` is omitted as already in `prose-inflation.slop-lexicon`. The `harness` forms are omitted on a MEASUREMENT: the only hit across 50 files in this repo was `### Any harness, without installing APM` in the README, the noun sense. Same defect that disqualified `ai-tells.FormalRegister` for `implement`.
